Package hu.bme.mit.theta.svlib.frontend.dsl.gen

Class SvLibBaseVisitor<T>

java.lang.Object
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.AbstractParseTreeVisitor<T>
hu.bme.mit.theta.svlib.frontend.dsl.gen.SvLibBaseVisitor<T>
Type Parameters:
T - The return type of the visit operation. Use Void for operations with no return type.
All Implemented Interfaces:
SvLibVisitor<T>, org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeVisitor<T>
public class SvLibBaseVisitor<T> extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.AbstractParseTreeVisitor<T> implements SvLibVisitor<T>
This class provides an empty implementation of SvLibVisitor, which can be extended to create a visitor which only needs to handle a subset of the available methods.
